# Collections Memo 2026-10-01 — Early-stage dialler corrections

**From:** Mira Okonkwo, Head of Collections Operations  
**To:** Dialler build / QA  
**Effective:** 2026-10-01  
**Applies to:** single-product early collections (1–45 days late)

This memo **supersedes** the 2026-07-01 policy extract wherever the two conflict. Unmentioned rules in the extract remain in force.

## 1. Additional holiday

Add **19 October 2026** (Freya Foundation Day) to the early-collections holiday list. Promise dates and deadlines must skip this day. The July extract's other holidays are unchanged.

Full holiday list after this memo:

- 2026-10-19
- 2026-10-26
- 2026-11-11
- 2026-11-26
- 2026-12-25
- 2027-01-01

## 2. Shorter late-band deadline

For the **late** band (8 to 45 days past due), the latest promise date is now the **5th business day after today**, not the 7th.

The early band is unchanged: 1 to 7 days late → 12th business day after today.

Persuasion attempt counts are unchanged (early: 1, late: 2).

## 3. Replacement confirmation sentence

Strike the July extract sentence about a "text message confirming this promise."

After `create_promise` returns `ok: true`, the agent must say exactly:

> A confirmation SMS will be sent to the mobile number on file.

No other wording satisfies this requirement.

## Reminder

Business days remain Monday–Friday except the holidays listed above (including the new 19 October date). Internal outcome codes still map through `codes.csv` to the API outcome/reason strings.
